subject: I am in practice for the book/screen plays/scripts
author: SUFFUR
body:
If you read my Blogs, you will see that I am Dyslexic, so I write to get better at it, true Incognito, I do go on, but it's what my mind thinks, but I have to type fast to keep up with it. But the problem with writting is there is only 7 stories, the Greek's worked that out a couple of eons ago, and when I found that out, I have been looking for the 8th for almost 10 years, and still nothing concrete, but have an idea of how to get somewhere, but if it's good is another question?

Oh, Zombie, realized that if I wrote something and passed it to her for editing, it would be a lot shorter but then it would not really be my work but a collaberation, which is good, but then it would not be me and my mind, lol. Which is what a blog is supposed to be about, like a dairy, with less milk but some interesting bacteria, so a diary would be better??? See what I mean, rabblings of a mad man.

Not many people can follow what I am on about, I know at the time, but come back to it some time later I just don't have a clue?

I still like the 'good room' one, but needs to be updated.

Also with comments on blogs, people can ask, WTF! please explain, but no-one really does, or adds stuff, like when I ask for people to add, I'm like a "Stand Alone Complex", get read and people move on.

My forum stuff, is also long, but only because the subject matter is interesting so I give my 2p worth.

I have to be fired up to write, ask Boot about that, but it's just words, his roasting was the first I did, and I loved it, but it did come across, as deflamatory, and I apologized for it, but it was funny, for some, but harsh for others. The one I wrote about nee POW was good too, but got deleted, thing is though I insulted everyone with that one, but as long as people know it's all tongue in cheek stuff, it should pass most moderation.

The thing that I find interesting, is that people spend more time writting, than playing the games they write about, or go so of topic, that it's not viable for the forum anymore, but then it is still do do with the community, so should stay, but should be covered by it's title, so people can avoid it if they want.

What gets me is some of the anger that people feel for some things, it's good to be emotionable about some thing, but when every other word is a swear word, and they can't spell well, and end up making an ass of themselves, though can be entertaining, does not really get across what they really want to say, which can be sad, because with in what they write you get the jist, but not the real cause of the upset.

I agree with the freedom of speech but it does have to make sense.

See, now too long again and I have got lost.

Bye.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
